title: Groom Skincare Routine in India: A 4–6 Week Plan
ex: A simple groom skincare routine for India: a 4–6 week plan with daily steps, shaving tips and honest timelines for what you can see before the wedding.
rt: Groom Skincare Routine India: 4–6 Week Plan | Mirc Glow
rd: A groom skincare routine for India: a simple 4–6 week plan with cleansing, moisturiser, sunscreen and shaving tips, plus honest timelines for the wedding.
quick: Start at least 4–6 weeks before the wedding: cleanse twice daily, moisturise, wear SPF 30 every morning, shave with the grain and sleep well. Add one new product at a time, stop adding anything two weeks out, and book any facial 7–10 days before.
facts: A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks
Book any facial 7–10 days before the wedding
Shave with the grain and moisturise afterwards
